privacyPage.title: Privacy
body: This site is run by Studio Innové. We keep what we collect to a minimum.

Waitlist. If you join a Studio Originals waitlist we store your email address with our form provider, Formspree, and use it only to email you about that app. Reply to any email or write to us to be removed, and we delete it.
Calls. Booking a call happens on Cal.com, which handles the details you enter there under its own privacy policy.
Analytics. We use Vercel Analytics to count visits. It uses no cookies and does not identify you.
Contact. Questions about your data: contact.studioinnove@gmail.com.
